comment: Benchmark sets for scripts/snapshot.py. A set names a directory and the workloads in it.
A workload is found at <directory>/<name>/<name>, at <directory>/<name>/main, or at
<directory>/<name>. Workloads that are not there are skipped and named, so a set may
list more than one machine happens to have.
The embench sets live outside this repository and are assumed to be available one level higher by default. Build them first, or point --benchmarks
somewhere else. The sw set needs only this repository and a RISC-V cross compiler.

default.comment: Six embench workloads that cover the instruction mix the VP is used on. md5sum first.

md5sum.comment: The single reference workload. Use it for a quick check while working.

embench.comment: Everything embench builds. Slow; for a release measurement rather than a working one.

sw.comment: The programs in this repository. Tiny, so the timings are noise, but they need nothing but a cross compiler and they exercise the trace features by name.
